title: Patient Invoices & Statements — Prompt-Pay Discount Rates and Courtesy Adjustment Limits
content:
Two billing classes of Patient Invoices & Statements carry a prompt-pay discount, two allow a courtesy adjustment, and three prohibit any waiver of cost share. The figures are fixed per billing class as follows.

| | Self-Pay Patient Invoice | Consumer Test Purchase Invoice | Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice | Medicaid Copay Invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prompt-pay discount, percent of the balance due | 15 | 0 | 0 | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| Prompt-pay window, calendar days after the first statement date | 30 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 0 | 0 |
| Discount earned only by a single payment of the full discounted balance | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Largest courtesy adjustment per invoice (USD) | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Waiver of cost share prohibited | No | No | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Prompt-pay discount**: the percent of the balance due taken off when the whole balance is paid within the prompt-pay window. A figure of 0 means no discount.
- **Prompt-pay window**: the calendar days after the first statement date during which payment in full earns the prompt-pay discount. A figure of 0 means there is no window.
- **Single payment of the full discounted balance**: whether only a single payment of the full discounted balance earns the discount. The answer is Yes on every class.
- **Largest courtesy adjustment**: the largest courtesy adjustment per invoice for a documented laboratory service failure. 0.00 means none is allowed.
- **Waiver of cost share prohibited**: whether cost share may not be waived or discounted except through approved financial assistance.

## Class by class

| Billing class | Prompt-pay discount | Courtesy adjustment | Cost-share waiver |
|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Patient Invoice | 15 percent within 30 days | up to 25.00 | not prohibited |
| Consumer Test Purchase Invoice | none | none | not prohibited |
| Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | none | none | prohibited except through approved financial assistance |
| Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | 10 percent within 30 days | up to 25.00 | not prohibited |
| Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice | none | none | prohibited except through approved financial assistance |
| Medicaid Copay Invoice | none | none | prohibited except through approved financial assistance |

A hypothetical courtesy adjustment of 25.00 on a Self-Pay Patient Invoice is within the class limit; 25.01 is above it. On the Consumer Test Purchase Invoice the limit of 0.00 means no courtesy adjustment at all.
